messages:
lena-partner-success: FYI were seeing a spike in entitlement-mapping failures for the SI partner NexusWorks after their go-live yesterday. ~1.8% of events are failing map_to_customer.

arjun-eng: Any sample payloads? most mapping issues are either missing external_customer_id or mismatched plan_id namespace.

lena-partner-success: pasted sanitized sample below (they said theyre compressing with gzip and then base64):
```json
{
  "envelope": {
    "source": "nexusworks",
    "ts": "2026-03-20T17:23:00Z",
    "payload_encoding": "gzip+base64",
    "signature_alg": "sha256_rsa"
  },
  "usage": {
    "customer_ref": null,
    "usage_units": 120,
    "sku": "redwood.inference.token",
    "plan": "monthly-standard"
  }
}
```

clare-billing: null customer_ref is the issue for mapping. We need either external_customer_id or partner_customer_map {partner_id -> redwood_customer_id}. Do they have one?

lena-partner-success: They claim theyve been sending partner_customer_map in a separate daily manifest but yesterday's manifest failed due to timezone munging. Their manifest uses PST dates while we interpret as UTC, so the reconciliation window skipped it.

marta-ops: Looking at ingester logs: map_to_customer error: `missing_partner_key` and downstream ledger wrote to unknown_customer bucket. We flagged roughly 2.1k events. Also signature verification shows repeated `invalid_key_format` for rsa signatures because they included a PEM header with extra CRLF and a BOM.

arjun-eng: Two separate fixes: 1) temporary tolerant mapping: if `customer_ref` is null, look up partner manifest by partner_batch_id + day, but only for 48h grace. 2) signature parsing: strip BOM and tolerate extra whitespace in PEM. I'll scope a small change for the parsing routine.

sam-partnerships: How risky is the tolerant mapping? We should avoid accidentally attributing usage to wrong accounts.

clare-billing: If we take the mapping from a manifest, ensure we also verify a content-hash match between manifest and usage batches to avoid mixups. Require partner to include `manifest_hash` on each batch. If not present, reject for now.

marta-ops: For backfill plan: we can run a controlled repair job that moves events from unknown_customer bucket to canonical customers after manifest verification. Need approval from billing for any ledger corrections > $100 per customer.

lena-partner-success: NexusWorks is ready to re-publish today's manifest with explicit UTC timestamps and manifest_hash. Theyre asking for a safe replay window of 3 days.

arjun-eng: I can put a hotfix in the parser to strip BOM and skip whitespace in PEM parse (20-30m). For the mapping lookup shim, I'll implement a guarded path that only applies if partner_batch_id is present and manifest_hash validates. That way we don't open a general hole. Estimate 3 hours dev+test+staging deploy.

ingest-bot: Incident created: PART-1133 - "NexusWorks manifest timezone + PEM parsing causing customer mapping failures" (priority P2). Attached sample failed batch IDs: [nw-20260320-17-1, nw-20260320-17-2, nw-20260320-18-7].

clare-billing: Please include a CSV audit template for the repair run: columns: partner_batch_id, original_bucket, candidate_customer_id, amount_adjusted_usd, justification, manifest_hash_verified (Y/N). Finance will review before any ledger change > $100.

sam-partnerships: I'll coordinate with NexusWorks to resend manifest and confirm manifest_hash. Also want a short customer-facing note template in case we need to notify a customer about a correction. Legal/comms review required.

marta-ops: Action items: [arjun-eng] PEM/BOM tolerant parse hotfix + PR, [arjun-eng] guarded manifest-lookup shim for null customer_ref, [clare-billing] audit CSV template + approval thresholds, [lena-partner-success] coordinate manifest resend and 3-day replay permission, [sam-partnerships] comms/legal loop in. Target: hotfix to staging in next 4 hours; repair scheduled after manifest verification.

lena-partner-success: NexusWorks engineering on call at 18:00 PT to walk through manifest hash generation. :phone:

arjun-eng: I'll post the hotfix branch shortly and ping for a quick review.

ingest-bot: Repair job scheduled (dry-run) -> job 89201, target window: 2026-03-20T16:00:00Z to 2026-03-20T19:00:00Z.
